capabilities: Render Markdown inside outline view entries
disambiguation: It does not create outlines; it changes how the existing outline view displays entries.
extras: Not yet available in the community plugin directory; installation requires BRAT. The underlying bug it was written to fix was resolved in Obsidian v1.5.4, so its purpose now is mainly the Markdown rendering option. Asks for donations via buy-me-a-coffee.
intentEvidence: This plugin was originally developed to fix a bug of the built-in outline view
motivation: The author originally developed it to fix a bug in the built-in outline view, which has since been fixed in Obsidian v1.5.4.
problem: Obsidian's built-in outline view displays entries as plain text without rendering Markdown formatting.

relations.evidence: Install the latest version of BRAT and enable it.

summary: Outline view enhancement that renders Markdown formatting inside outline entries instead of showing raw text.
